scope: Day 4 persistent diagnostic tracing, exporter, fault-trace checks and bounded real-ROS integration
source_state: Local Day 4 working tree identified by hashes; private planning documents remain local

implementation.storage: Dedicated SQLite database; bounded non-waiting enqueue with background writer
implementation.retention: Oldest events removed by count/payload budget; main database capped by SQLite pages; rollback journal is additional space
implementation.usage: Reported final HTTP response token counts and explicit cost_usd; missing fields stay null, retries/custom adapters may add unknown usage
implementation.credentials: Configured credential registration/redaction, credential-field and text-pattern redaction; no HTTP bodies, headers, URLs or image bytes recorded
implementation.export: placecell-export-trace / python -m placecell.trace_export, read-only, optional mission ID, no overwrite
implementation.ros_profile: mission_trace_path enabled in simulation/config/missions.yaml; ROS status payload unchanged

regressions.shutdown_idle: Real ROS check exposed idle shutdown feedback being attached to a finished mission; fixed attribution and added a dedicated regression test
regressions.late_work: Late model callbacks retain their original mission IDs after cancellation and a new request
regressions.blocked_writer: A controlled blocked trace writer and full queue do not prevent the tested stop callback issuing cancellation
regressions.trace_write_failure: Scripted two-goal mission still completes while trace writes fail; loss counters expose the diagnostic failure
regressions.ambiguity: Selection and stop requests preserve the original mission ID and distinct request IDs
regressions.interruption: Child process exits inside an open span; retained trace identifies an open session/unfinished span, and reopen records unclean shutdown

validation.installed_cli: Offline editable install; installed exporter executed for all retained traces and a selected mission ID

fault_campaign.claim: Sequential scripted software repeatability; not independent perception examples or live-motion qualification

ros_check.source_mounts: Current src/placecell and simulation mounted read-only; image not rebuilt

checks.scope: Real ROS node, parameter service, command/status topics and unavailable-action-server path; no Gazebo motion

ros_check.parameter_overrides: use_sim_time=false; temporary in-container database/context/keyframe/trace paths; second case mission_enabled=false
ros_check.motion: No Gazebo or active Nav2 server; real ROS admission, topics, unavailable-server result and shutdown only

validation.remote_ci: Not run for these local changes

limitations: Trace capture is best-effort diagnostic evidence, not an audit log or movement replay source
File-backed writer lock targets Linux/Unix; general node defaults keep tracing disabled
Arbitrary unlabelled sensitive text is not reliably classifiable; review exports before sharing
No measured physical stop latency, live-model quality, moving Gazebo campaign or 24-hour endurance
